semantics.clock: posedge clk, per original final sentence
semantics.reset: posedge areset asynchronous, active high; resets to 2'b01 per original reset sentence; reset has priority while asserted
semantics.training: On each rising clock edge with reset low and train_valid high, increment if train_taken high, otherwise decrement
semantics.latency: state updates at the triggering edge with no additional pipeline cycles
semantics.initialization: No power-up initialization specified; no initial value is imposed

verification.oracle: Independent integer bounded-step model derived from original problem
verification.sampling: Drive training before rising edge and inspect after nonblocking assignments; check asynchronous reset away from clock edges
verification.coverage: All four states and training input combinations; saturation, disabled hold, reset priority, reset release, falling-edge and between-edge stability
verification.timeout: Bounded simulation timeout with fatal mismatches and final PASS marker

specification_ambiguities: Power-up value before the first reset is unspecified; verification does not require a particular initial value.
